legal_entity: Not stated on the affiliate page; the site footer names Netcoins Inc. (FINTRAC MSB M15560893), owned by Surge Digital Inc. (TSXV: SRGE).
application_conditions: 'Apply to become an affiliate below!' — Google Forms application reviewed by the Netcoins team; applicants must be at least 18 (or the age of majority) and hold 'a verified Netcoins account in good standing'; approved affiliates sign 'the Affiliate Agreement' before receiving a link or code. The form asks whether the applicant resides in Canada or the US.
paid_action: Valid referral: a new customer who completes KYC, funds the account (at least 'typically $100 CAD') and trades at least 'typically $100 CAD' within '7 days'. Card orders are not a paid action.
validation_conditions: KYC completed, funding and trade of about $100 CAD each within 7 days (page wording 'typically').

commission.model_note: 'fixed referral commissions based on your monthly tier performance': Tier 1 $20 per user (0–10 users/month), Tier 2 $30 (11–20), Tier 3 $40 (21+). Referred users also receive '$10 for free on us'.
commission.tiers_note: $20 / $30 / $40 CAD per valid referral depending on the number of referred users in the month (0–10 / 11–20 / 21+).

payout.holdbacks_note: Not stated; the Affiliate Agreement is named but not linked. The footer links a 'Referral TOS' (netcoins.com/referral-tos) not read in this run.

rules_note: No affiliate platform named (direct programme). The Netcoins Prepaid Mastercard is not mentioned on the affiliate page. Separate customer Referral Program (netcoins.com/referral-program): when the referred friend verifies, funds and trades at least $100, 'you each receive $15 in CAD' to the Netcoins cash balance; no referral limit. Nobody contacted, no application made.
allowed_countries_note: Not stated; the application form asks for Canada or US residence. The card itself is for Canadian residents outside Quebec.
